info.title: FileX events
info.description: Implemented owner WebSocket notifications and outbound signed webhooks. PostgreSQL outbox is authoritative. At-least-once delivery; consumers persist and deduplicate event IDs.

owner.description: Cookie and exact Origin; resume with after cursor. Falls back to GET /notifications. Rechecks session every second; no recipient identity.

webhook.description: Public IPv4 HTTPS:443, no redirect/proxy. X-FileX-Event-ID matches signed eventId; X-FileX-Timestamp within 300s; X-FileX-Signature is hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + dot + exact body). Persist eventId atomically with consumer effects. Retry 8 attempts then dead; manual resend retains ID.
